title: Algorithms Seed Data Schema
description: JSON Schema for Rubik's Cube algorithm seed data files (seeddata_algorithms_*.json). Each algorithm represents a move sequence for solving a specific method case. Each case typically has multiple algorithm options with different characteristics.

case_id.description: Foreign key reference to cases table (which case this algorithm solves). Must reference an existing case.

code.description: Unique code identifier for the algorithm within its case (e.g., 'ua-1', 'ua-2', 't-perm-standard', 'CLL-U-01-01')

sequence.description: Move notation sequence for the algorithm. Empty string allowed for 'Skip' cases where no moves needed. Uses standard Rubik's Cube notation: R, L, U, D, F, B (and their primes/doubles)
examples: R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'
M2 U M2 U2 M2 U M2

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the algorithm (e.g., 'Sune', 'T Perm', 'Sexy Move')

tags.description: Classification tags for the algorithm (e.g., characteristics, fingertrick styles, speed ratings)

popularity.description: Popularity score from 0 (least popular) to 100 (most popular). Default is 50 if not specified.

avg_moves.description: Average number of moves in the algorithm (Quarter Turn Metric or similar)

avg_execution_time_ms.description: Average execution time in milliseconds for experienced cubers

story.description: Educational content for algorithm execution tips, fingertricks, recognition aids, or mnemonics

created_at.description: Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format with timezone

description: Array must contain at least one algorithm
